item.title: Cloquet Girls Basketball Holds on Against Hermantown to Advance to the 7AAA Title Game
item.description: HERMANTOWN, Minn.- The Hermantown girls basketball team clashed with Cloquet in the 7AAA semifinal round on Saturday. The Lumberjacks pull off the upset, taking down the Hawks 46-42 to advance to the 7AAA title game. Cloquet will face Rock Ridge in the 7AAA championship game on Thursday, March 5th. item.title: UWS Women’s Basketball Grabs UMAC Title, Taking Down North Central
item.description: SUPERIOR, Wis.- The UWS women’s basketball team tipped off against North Central in the UMAC championship game on Saturday night. The Yellowjackets defended their home floor, taking down the Rams 78-51 to secure the 2026 UMAC title. Leading the way for UWS was Maddie Reott with 23 points.
